+"""Intent tests for M1-T16 (risk.log_returns): RISK-01 and TC-04."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import itertools
+import math
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from mdata import Prices
+from risk import Returns, log_returns
+
+
+def _prices(d: dict[str, Any]) -> Prices:
+    return Prices(
+        dates=tuple(d["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(d["tickers"]),
+        closes={t: tuple(v) for t, v in d["closes"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc04_geometric_closes_give_the_closed_form_returns(golden):
+    """TC-04: closes 100*1.01^t and 50*0.98^t give every return ln(1.01), ln(0.98)."""
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-04")
+    returns = log_returns(_prices(data["prices"]))
+    assert isinstance(returns, Returns)
+    assert returns.base_date == expected["base_date"]
+    assert returns.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
+    assert returns.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
+    assert set(returns.values) == set(expected["values"])
+    for ticker, want in expected["values"].items():
+        assert len(returns.values[ticker]) == len(want)
+        assert returns.values[ticker] == pytest.approx(want, abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_returns_are_dated_after_the_base_date(contract_sample):
+    """Returns invariant: dates are the prices' dates after the first, which is base_date."""
+    prices = _prices(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))
+    returns = log_returns(prices)
+    assert returns.base_date == prices.dates[0]
+    assert returns.dates == prices.dates[1:]
+    assert returns.tickers == prices.tickers
+    for ticker in prices.tickers:
+        assert len(returns.values[ticker]) == len(prices.dates) - 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_each_return_is_the_log_of_consecutive_closes(contract_sample):
+    """RISK-01: r_t = ln(close_t / close_t-1), dated t."""
+    prices = _prices(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))
+    returns = log_returns(prices)
+    for ticker, closes in prices.closes.items():
+        want = [math.log(b / a) for a, b in itertools.pairwise(closes)]
+        assert returns.values[ticker] == pytest.approx(want, abs=1e-12)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_fewer_than_two_dates_is_a_value_error():
+    """risk.log_returns errors: ValueError with fewer than two dates."""
+    one_date = Prices(dates=("2024-01-02",), tickers=("X",), closes={"X": (100.0,)})
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)(two|2|date)"):
+        log_returns(one_date)
